subject.title: iOS: keychain save fails on fresh install (cal save failed / disconnected because it could not securely save)

question: What signed-device evidence is required before choosing an iOS Keychain code or release-signing repair for this onboarding failure?
rationale: The current API collapses every Security.framework failure to false, while changing accessibility, access groups, or fallback behavior affects a credential-security boundary; source inspection cannot safely distinguish those causes.

options.title: Require native diagnostics first
options.body: Collect redacted OSStatus, effective signed entitlements, access-group details, device protection state, and a physical-device fresh-install reproduction before selecting the repair.

options.title: Ship diagnostic-only recovery
options.body: Add a user-visible retry and diagnostic export path without changing secure-storage semantics, then use resulting field evidence to choose the repair.

options.title: Change persistence immediately
options.body: Modify accessibility or storage behavior based on the current report, accepting that the exact failing Security.framework contract remains unproven.

recommendation.title: Require native diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Collect redacted OSStatus, effective signed entitlements, access-group details, device protection state, and a physical-device fresh-install reproduction before selecting the repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available current iOS routing candidate and were directly engaged on the issue timeline.
